cue.en: Set your feet about shoulder-width apart.

rationale.en: A balanced base speeds up the first step.

cue.en: Soften your knees so you are ready to move.

rationale.en: Straight knees delay the first step.

AMBIGUOUS_SUBJECT.en: Two people are in view. Please make sure only you are in the frame.

FRAMING_INVALID.en: Step back so your whole body, including your feet, is visible.

MISSING_JOINT.en: Some joints are hidden. Keep your full body in view.

LOW_CONFIDENCE.en: Tracking is unsteady. Improve lighting and face the camera.

VIEW_INVALID.en: This check needs a different camera angle; it is paused for now.

TIME_GAP.en: Tracking paused. Resume when you are ready.

TRACK_CHANGED.en: Lost track of you for a moment. Checks restart now.

HANDEDNESS_UNKNOWN.en: Set your paddle hand in the session setup to enable arm checks.

CAPABILITY_MISSING.en: Paddle or ball tracking is not active, so contact checks are off.

CONTACT_UNOBSERVED.en: Ball contact cannot be seen from body tracking alone.
